slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated identifier. Must match the resource filename (without extension). Ids are unique across the whole registry.

disclosure.description: How much of the underlying system is public. Athenara rewards transparency but never requires giving away an edge.

prereqLevel.description: none = no familiarity needed; basic = introductory familiarity; moderate = working knowledge; advanced = deep hands-on experience; expert = specialist.

prerequisites.description: What this entry assumes of its user, per axis — so a beginner and an expert can each find what fits. Rate honestly; entries are findable by these on the Browse page.

trading.description: Trading/markets knowledge assumed, e.g. order types, backtesting concepts, market microstructure.

ai.description: AI/ML/agentic knowledge assumed, e.g. LLM prompting, RL training, agent frameworks.

programming.description: Software engineering skill assumed to use it.

setup.description: Installation/setup effort: none = nothing to install (e.g. a paper), basic = one command, moderate = config plus API keys, advanced = multi-service or GPU setup, expert = research code you must assemble yourself.

runnable.description: How to actually run this resource — the fields that turn a catalog entry into something usable.

install.description: Verbatim, copy-pasteable install commands, in order.

entrypoint.description: The command that starts it, verbatim.

requires.description: External prerequisites a user must have: API keys, market-data subscriptions, GPU, broker account, e.g. 'OpenAI API key', 'Alpaca paper account'.

summary.description: One factual sentence. No marketing language.

authors.description: People or organizations behind the resource.

origin.description: external = lives elsewhere (e.g. GitHub), Athenara is the discovery layer. native = published on Athenara.

markets.description: Markets covered, e.g. equities, crypto, forex, futures, multi-asset.

superseded_by.description: Slug of the entry (same section) that replaces this one, if it is obsolete.

implements.description: Knowledge-graph edge → architectures: patterns or frameworks this entry realizes.

paper.description: Knowledge-graph edge → papers: research describing this entry.

uses_dataset.description: Knowledge-graph edge → datasets this entry trains or evaluates on.

evaluated_on.description: Knowledge-graph edge → benchmarks this entry has been evaluated on.

reproduces.description: Knowledge-graph edge → papers: published work this entry independently reproduces.

builds_on.description: Knowledge-graph edge → any section: prior work this entry directly extends.
